thread.title: Special Participation A: Gemini 3 pro on HW 8
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>I used <bold>Gemini 3 Pro</bold> to solve the non‑coding portion of <bold>HW 8</bold>. Overall, Gemini did an excellent job producing clear and well‑structured mathematical derivations, often matching the logical flow of the official solutions. I especially appreciated its ability to organize the reasoning into intuitive steps and explain the purpose behind each transformation. Gemini sometimes took a slightly different path to reach the final answer, but its results were fully consistent after minor prompting. Overall, I was impressed by its precision, presentation quality, and the clarity of its mathematical reasoning.</paragraph><paragraph/><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/woyKGrCUftrJJQ6Fn5M3mbF0" filename="A_Gemini_3_pro.pdf"/></document>
thread.document: I used Gemini 3 Pro to solve the non‑coding portion of HW 8. Overall, Gemini did an excellent job producing clear and well‑structured mathematical derivations, often matching the logical flow of the official solutions. I especially appreciated its ability to organize the reasoning into intuitive steps and explain the purpose behind each transformation. Gemini sometimes took a slightly different path to reach the final answer, but its results were fully consistent after minor prompting. Overall, I was impressed by its precision, presentation quality, and the clarity of its mathematical reasoning.
